sessions.title: Market Research Sprint: First Picks
sessions.objective: Break the zero-output streak. Produce 3-5 market research picks using WebSearch/WebFetch and documented methods.

step_by_step_workflow.action: Coordinator reads TEAM-0033/0034 session logs and roadmap_5_sessions.json, briefs team on zero-infrastructure rule
Gather macro backdrop: S&P 500, VIX, Fed funds rate, inflation, GDP growth, yield curve
Screen 3-4 sectors for catalysts, relative performance, and macro tailwinds
Gather news sentiment, insider transactions, analyst consensus for top 2 sectors
Screen 8-10 candidate stocks within selected sectors using fundamental criteria from fundamental.md
Apply fundamental.md checklist to top 5 candidates: P/E, revenue growth, FCF, ROIC, moat
Apply sentiment.md checklist: insider activity, analyst ratings, news flow, institutional positioning
Merge fundamental + sentiment scores, rank by composite, select top 3-5 for picks
Create pick files using TEMPLATE.md for each selected stock
Update market-research/picks/index.json with new picks
Create KB entry documenting methodology, macro conditions, and sector analysis
Write session log with actual domain/infra/overhead split

agent_prompts.coordinator: You are the coordinator for a Market Research Sprint. Your ONLY job is to ensure the team produces 3-5 market research picks. ZERO infrastructure work is allowed. Read roadmap_5_sessions.json for context. Time-box: sector screening 10 min, stock screening 15 min, analysis 15 min. If any agent proposes building a tool, redirect them immediately. Quality gate: every pick must have entry_price, target_price, stop_loss, and a clear thesis supported by data from 2+ sources. Use WebSearch and WebFetch exclusively.
agent_prompts.research_a: You are Research Team A (Fundamental + Macro). Your tasks: (1) Establish macro backdrop using WebSearch - search for 'S&P 500 performance 2026', 'Fed funds rate March 2026', 'US inflation CPI latest', 'VIX current level', 'US GDP growth 2026'. Summarize in 200+ words. (2) Screen 3-4 sectors using WebSearch for sector ETF performance (XLK, XLF, XLE, XLV, XLI). Pick sectors with catalysts. (3) Screen 8-10 stocks within chosen sectors using WebSearch for company financials. Apply fundamental.md criteria: P/E < sector median, positive revenue growth, positive FCF, reasonable debt. Share candidate list with other agents.
agent_prompts.research_b: You are Research Team B (Sentiment + News). Your tasks: (1) For each candidate stock from Research Team A, search for recent news, analyst ratings, insider transactions, and institutional positioning using WebSearch. (2) Apply sentiment.md checklist to each candidate. Score on: insider activity (buying=bullish), analyst consensus (upgrades vs downgrades), news sentiment (positive/negative/neutral), institutional flow. (3) Flag any red flags: pending lawsuits, regulatory issues, accounting concerns, management departures.
agent_prompts.analyst: You are the Analysis / Cross-Validation agent. Your tasks: (1) Receive fundamental scores from Research A and sentiment scores from Research B. (2) Create composite score for each candidate: fundamental 50%, sentiment 30%, macro fit 20%. (3) Rank all candidates by composite score. (4) Select top 3-5 with composite >= 6.0/10. (5) For each selected pick, verify it's supported by at least 2 methods (fundamental + sentiment). (6) Set entry_price (current market price via WebSearch), target_price (based on upside analysis), stop_loss (support level or -15% max).
agent_prompts.writer: You are the Writer / Indexer. Your tasks: (1) Create pick files using market-research/picks/TEMPLATE.md format. Fill ALL YAML frontmatter fields: pick_id (auto-increment from index.json), date, team (TEAM-0035), ticker, company, direction, method, entry_price, target_price, stop_loss, timeframe, confidence, status (active), builds_on. Fill body: ## Thesis (2-3 sentences), ## Analysis (### Method Applied, ### Key Metrics, ### Risk Factors), ## Exit Criteria. (2) Update market-research/picks/index.json. (3) Create 1 KB entry about research methodology and findings. (4) Write session log.

sessions.data_sharing_plan: Research A shares macro_backdrop and candidate_list as data files in storage/data/. Research B reads candidate_list and produces sentiment_scores. Analyst reads both score sets. Writer reads final selections. All sharing via files in storage/data/session_1/.
quality_gates: Every pick has all TEMPLATE.md YAML fields populated
Every pick cites >= 2 data sources in analysis
Every pick has falsifiable thesis (not vague)
Entry price is current market price (within 1%)
Target price and stop loss specified
At least 2 methods support the pick direction
Minimum 3 picks produced
contingency_plans: If 30 min in with no candidates: reduce sector screening, pick obvious large-cap stocks (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL) and do fundamental + sentiment analysis
If data quality poor from WebSearch: try WebFetch on specific URLs (finance.yahoo.com, marketwatch.com)
If analysis paralysis on stock selection: time-box to 15 min, pick best available not perfect

sessions.title: Financial Data Integration + More Picks

step_by_step_workflow.action: Review Session 1 outputs, validate picks still current
Install Yahoo Finance MCP server (no auth, most reliable)
Install EdgarTools MCP server for SEC filings
Install Alpha Vantage MCP (if API key available)
Build pick_logger.py (create_pick, update_pick, list_picks, get_performance)
Research Team gathers financial data using new MCP servers for 8-10 candidates
Sentiment + macro update: fresh news, insider activity, analyst changes
Cross-validate Session 1 picks with new MCP data, update if needed
Create 3-5 new pick files using pick_logger.py
Create KB entry on MCP financial tools evaluation
Write session log

agent_prompts.coordinator: Manage Session 2: Financial Data Integration + More Picks. Infrastructure agent has 45 min max to set up MCP servers + build pick_logger. If MCP setup takes >15 min per server, skip and use WebSearch fallback. Verify each MCP server returns data before research starts. Quality gate all picks.
agent_prompts.infrastructure: You are the Infrastructure agent. Tasks in order: (1) Install Yahoo Finance MCP: try 'uvx mcp-yahoo-finance', add to .mcp.json. Test with MSFT quote. (2) Install EdgarTools MCP: 'pip install edgartools[mcp]', add to .mcp.json with EDGAR_IDENTITY env var. Test with AAPL 10-K. (3) Install Alpha Vantage MCP if key available: add to .mcp.json. Test with AAPL quote. (4) Build pick_logger.py: 180 LOC script with create_pick, update_pick, list_picks, get_performance functions. Standard library only. Atomic file writes. CLI with argparse subcommands.
agent_prompts.research_fundamental: Use MCP financial tools (Yahoo Finance, Alpha Vantage, EdgarTools) to gather comprehensive data on 8-10 candidates. Apply fundamental.md + technical.md checklists with numeric data (P/E, RSI, MACD, revenue growth). If MCP tools unavailable, fall back to WebSearch.
agent_prompts.research_sentiment: Gather fresh sentiment data and validate Session 1 picks. Use Yahoo Finance MCP for analyst ratings and insider transactions. WebSearch for news flow. Update macro backdrop from Session 1. Flag any material changes since last session.
agent_prompts.writer: Log all new picks via pick_logger.py. Create KB entry documenting which MCP servers work, their capabilities, and rate limits. Write session log.

sessions.data_sharing_plan: MCP servers provide shared data access. Infrastructure agent writes status to storage/data/mcp_setup_status.json. Research agents read MCP results. Writer uses pick_logger.py for standardized output.
quality_gates: At least 1 MCP server returning valid data
pick_logger.py creates valid pick files matching TEMPLATE.md
Session 1 picks validated with current data
3+ new picks logged
All indexes updated
contingency_plans: If all MCP servers fail: use WebSearch (proven in Session 1), document failures for retry
If pick_logger not ready: manually create picks using TEMPLATE.md (Session 1 method)
If Alpha Vantage rate limited: use Yahoo Finance MCP (no limits) as primary

sessions.title: SEC EDGAR Integration + Sector Deep Dive

step_by_step_workflow.action: Review Sessions 1-2 outputs, identify target sector for deep dive
Build method_sec_edgar.py OR method_fred.py (depends on EdgarTools MCP status)
Deep-dive sector analysis: 5-8 companies compared across valuation, growth, profitability
Macro + cross-sector analysis: update backdrop, compare target vs alternatives
Validate Sessions 1-2 picks still performing
Create 3-5 picks from sector deep dive using multi-method analysis
Create sector analysis KB entry
Write session log

agent_prompts.coordinator: Session 3: SEC EDGAR + Sector Deep Dive. DECISION-01: If EdgarTools MCP works from Session 2, coding agent builds method_fred.py instead of method_sec_edgar.py (pull FRED forward). Identify target sector based on Sessions 1-2 findings. Time-box coding to 45 min. Quality gate all picks.
agent_prompts.coding: CONDITIONAL: If EdgarTools MCP failed → build method_sec_edgar.py using raw SEC EDGAR REST API (data.sec.gov). Follow existing method_*.py patterns. Core endpoints: company_tickers.json for CIK lookup, companyfacts for XBRL data. If EdgarTools MCP works → build method_fred.py for FRED economic data (GDP, CPI, UNRATE, DFF, T10Y2Y). Both scripts: ~150 LOC, standard library + requests, CLI interface, error handling.
agent_prompts.research_sector: Comprehensive analysis of 1 sector (5-8 companies). Use all MCP tools + SEC filings for fundamental data. Build comparison matrix: P/E, EV/EBITDA, revenue growth, margins, ROIC, debt/equity, analyst consensus. Rank companies within sector. Apply quantitative.md screening criteria.
agent_prompts.research_macro: Update macro backdrop. Compare target sector vs alternatives using sector ETF performance. Identify cross-sector catalysts and risks. Check all Session 1-2 picks for performance vs entry price.
agent_prompts.writer: Create 3-5 picks from deep dive using pick_logger.py. Create KB entry with sector comparison matrix. Grade research quality. Write session log.

sessions.data_sharing_plan: Coding agent publishes tool status. Research agents share via direct channel. Writer reads all outputs.
quality_gates: New tool functional for test inputs
Sector analysis covers 5+ companies
3+ new picks from deep dive
Cumulative picks >= 9
All prior picks validated
contingency_plans: If SEC EDGAR API too complex: ship minimal tool (filing list only), iterate later
If sector deep dive takes too long: reduce to 3-4 companies
If XBRL parsing fails: use WebSearch to read filing summaries instead

sessions.title: Data Hygiene Sprint + Portfolio Review

step_by_step_workflow.action: Review Gamma audit items, partition bug fixes vs domain work
Index 15 orphaned scripts in storage/scripts/index.json
Add TEAM-0032 + TEAM-0033 + TEAM-0034 to sessions/index.json
Backfill titles into 34 KB entries YAML frontmatter
Fix TOCTOU-WS-001: add BEGIN IMMEDIATE + WHERE guard to complete_work
Fix TOCTOU-HP-001: wrap both UPDATEs in BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
Fix TOCTOU-MTR-004: add threading.Event double-stop guard
Merge duplicate FRED source SRC-0018/SRC-0039
Gather current prices for all Session 1-3 picks, calculate performance
Review news/sentiment changes, recommend hold/sell/add for each pick
Update pick files with performance data and review notes
Create portfolio performance KB entry, write session log

agent_prompts.coordinator: Session 4: Data Hygiene + Portfolio Review. Infrastructure agent has approved fix list (7 items). NO scope expansion. Domain work = portfolio review (3 agents). Time-box infra fixes to 80 min total. If infra agent finishes early, reassign to domain.
agent_prompts.infrastructure: Fix exactly these items in order: (1) Index 15 orphaned scripts, (2) Index TEAM-0032/0033/0034, (3) Backfill 34 KB titles from index.json, (4) Fix TOCTOU-WS-001 with BEGIN IMMEDIATE + WHERE guard (write test first), (5) Fix TOCTOU-HP-001 with transaction wrapping (write test first), (6) Fix TOCTOU-MTR-004 with threading.Event guard, (7) Merge FRED duplicates. DO NOT expand scope.
agent_prompts.portfolio_review_a: Gather current prices for every pick from Sessions 1-3 using Yahoo Finance MCP or WebSearch. Calculate: (current_price - entry_price) / entry_price * 100 for each. Check if any hit stop_loss or target_price. Produce performance summary table.
agent_prompts.portfolio_review_b: For each active pick: search for material changes since pick date (earnings, guidance, M&A, regulatory). Check insider transactions. Update analyst consensus. Recommend: HOLD (thesis intact), SELL (thesis broken), ADD (thesis strengthened). Produce 1-2 new picks if opportunities found.
agent_prompts.writer: Update each pick file with performance section. Create portfolio performance KB entry with aggregate stats. Validate all indexes after infrastructure fixes. Write session log.

sessions.data_sharing_plan: Infrastructure agent updates files directly. Portfolio review agents share findings via storage/data/session_4/. Writer integrates all.
quality_gates: 5+ of 7 data hygiene items completed
All TOCTOU fixes have passing regression tests
All prior picks have performance data
Portfolio review KB entry produced
All indexes validated
contingency_plans: If TOCTOU fixes too complex: ship partial fix, document remaining work
If portfolio review reveals all picks underwater: document lessons, adjust methodology for Session 5
If infrastructure fixes expand scope: coordinator halts immediately

sessions.title: Agent Skills + Expanded Domain Output

step_by_step_workflow.action: Review all Sessions 1-4 outputs, prepare for final session
Build method_fred.py (if not already built in Session 3)
Package market research workflow as Agent Skill (.skill.md)
Economic analysis: labor market, inflation, rates using FRED + BLS data
Produce 3-5 new picks targeting sectors identified by economic analysis
Create economic analysis KB entry
Create 5-session retrospective KB entry
Draft roadmap_sessions_6_10.json
Log new picks, update all indexes, write session log

agent_prompts.coordinator: Final session of the 5-session roadmap. Balance: method_fred.py + Agent Skill packaging (1 coding agent) with domain output (2 research agents, 1 writer). Draft Sessions 6-10 roadmap based on learnings. Retrospective must cover what worked, what failed, methodology improvements.
agent_prompts.coding: Tasks: (1) Build method_fred.py if not done in Session 3. Support key series: GDP, CPI, UNRATE, DFF, T10Y2Y. Use FRED API (https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations). CLI interface. Cache responses. ~120 LOC. (2) Package market research workflow as .skill.md Agent Skill. Include: data gathering steps referencing all MCP servers, checklist application from methods/, pick file creation via pick_logger.py, index update. Make it usable by any future agent.
agent_prompts.research_economic: Use method_fred.py (or WebSearch fallback) to gather: GDP growth trend (last 4 quarters), CPI inflation (last 12 months), unemployment rate trend, Fed funds rate, 10Y-2Y yield curve spread. Identify macro themes: expansion/contraction, inflation trajectory, rate expectations. Map themes to investment implications.
agent_prompts.research_picks: Using economic analysis themes + all available tools (MCP servers, SEC filings, WebSearch): produce 3-5 new picks with comprehensive multi-method analysis. Each pick should reference macro context. Target sectors aligned with economic themes.
agent_prompts.writer: Log picks via pick_logger.py. Create 2 KB entries: (1) economic analysis with current conditions, (2) 5-session retrospective with cumulative metrics (total picks, tools built, domain ratio achieved, what worked, what to improve). Write session log with full roadmap metrics.

sessions.data_sharing_plan: Coding agent publishes tool/skill. Research agents share via storage/data/session_5/. Writer integrates all. Coordinator produces next roadmap.
